subtitle: When the Shadow from Ghazni Met the Sword of Malwa

panels.shot: epic wide shot, map of northwestern India under a stormy sky, Bhoja of Dhara standing at Malwa’s edge looking toward a distant Ghazni-bound army in silhouette
panels.action: Bhoja of Dhara stands on a rocky Malwa escarpment, hand on sword, gazing north over a ghostly map where routes from Somnath, Hansi, Thanesar and Ghazni glow faintly like threads of fate.

dialogue.text: Persian chronicles whisper of a mighty Param Dev whom Mahmud avoided; inscriptions sing of Bhoja’s Turushka foes. Who was this shadowed king of Malwa in the age of Somnath’s aftermath?

i18n.hi: फ़ारसी कथाएँ उस बलवान परम देव की फुसफुसाहट करती हैं जिससे महमूद बचा; शिलालेख भोज के तुरुष्क दुश्मनों का गान करते हैं। सोमनाथ की आँधी के बाद मालवा का यह छाया-सा राजा कौन था?

panels.shot: somber bird’s-eye over the Gujarat coast, distant fortress of Somnath under a heavy sky, tiny Ghaznavid ranks like dark ants on the shoreline
panels.action: From high above the Arabian Sea, the stone complex of Somnath rises quiet on the shore while a dark line of Ghaznavid soldiers in ordered ranks marches away along the coast road.

dialogue.text: In 1025, Mahmud of Ghazni’s army reached Somnath on the Gujarat coast. Chronicles record shattered idols, taken wealth, and many lives broken in a sudden storm of steel.

i18n.hi: १०२५ में ग़ज़नी के महमूद की सेना गुजरात तट के सोमनाथ तक पहुँची। इतिहास में टूटे मूरतें, लूटा धन और लोहे की आँधी में बिखरी ज़िंदगियाँ दर्ज हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in on a parchment-style route map from Somnath to Ghazni, one bold line via the Ganga plain, another curving inland past Malwa, a shadowed hand hovering over the paths
panels.action: An aged hand hovers over a parchment map showing two inked routes from Somnath to Ghazni, one straight through the Ganga plain, another bending inland past Malwa, as if weighing danger.

dialogue.text: Later Persian writers say Mahmud altered his return, avoiding a powerful Hindu ruler called Param Dev. The story hangs over the map of India like a question left open.

i18n.hi: बाद के फ़ारसी लेखक लिखते हैं कि लौटते वक़्त महमूद ने रास्ता बदला, एक शक्तिशाली हिन्दू शासक परम देव से बचते हुए। यह कहानी भारत के नक़्शे पर अधूरा सवाल बनकर तैरती है।

panels.shot: regal interior wide of Bhoja’s court at Dhara, scholar-warrior king on a lion seat amid scrolls, weapons, and envoys from distant lands
panels.action: Inside the pillared hall of Dhara, Bhoja of Dhara sits straight-backed on a carved lion throne, one hand resting on a manuscript, the other on a sheathed sword, as envoys stand attentive.

dialogue.text: Far to the east in Malwa sat Bhoja, Paramara king of Dhara. Inscribed praise calls him a poet, engineer and warrior, a ruler whose fame spread beyond his own plateau.

i18n.hi: पूरब में मालवा में धारा का परमार राजा भोज बैठा था। शिलालेख उसे कवि, अभियंता और योद्धा कहते हैं—एक राजा जिसकी ख्याति अपने पठार से बहुत दूर तक गई।

panels.shot: medium shot of Bhoja in council, listening to a messenger from the northwest, tension in the faces of generals and priests around him
panels.action: Bhoja leans forward on his throne as a dust-covered messenger from the northwest bows, while generals and priests on either side watch with grave, expectant faces.

dialogue.text: Messengers brought news from the northwest—of Ghaznavid raids through Punjab, of the Kabul Shahi kingdom pushed back, of temples emptied and towns shaken.

i18n.hi: दूत उत्तर-पश्चिम से खबरें लाए—पंजाब पर ग़ज़नवी हमले, काबुल शाही राज्य की पीछे धकेली सीमा, उजड़े मंदिर और हिलते हुए नगर।

panels.shot: evocative side view of Bhoja rising, a mural behind him showing rivers and forts, his profile set in determination
panels.action: Bhoja rises from the throne, jaw set, before a painted wall map of rivers and forts; his hand firmly grips the hilt at his waist, the court watching his decision form in silence.

dialogue.speaker: bhoja_of_dhara
dialogue.text: If the north burns, Malwa will not stand idle. We will be ready.

i18n.hi: अगर उत्तर जल रहा है तो मालवा चुप नहीं रहेगा। हम तैयार रहेंगे।

panels.shot: montage wide showing Kabul Shahi banners retreating through mountain passes, then a sun-baked road with refugee bands heading toward central India
panels.action: In one sweeping scene, battered standards of the Kabul Shahis vanish into a snow-lined pass, fading into another view of weary refugees and horsemen trudging along a dusty road toward the plains.

dialogue.text: The Shahi rulers of Kabul and Gandhara were losing ground. Traditions say that Trilochanapala, a Shahi prince, sought shelter far away from Ghazni’s reach.

i18n.hi: काबुल और गांधार के शाही राजा ज़मीन खो रहे थे। परंपरा कहती है कि शाही राजकुमार त्रिलोचनपाल ग़ज़नी से दूर कहीं शरण लेने निकला।

panels.shot: intimate court interior, Bhoja offering a gesture of welcome to a cloaked foreign prince figure, guards and priests looking on at this act of refuge
panels.action: In Bhoja’s dimly lit audience hall, he extends an open hand of welcome toward a cloaked, travel-worn prince with Central Asian features, while guards and priests look on, surprised and solemn.

dialogue.text: Later accounts remember Bhoja as a giver of refuge to a Shahi prince like Trilochanapala. The exiled line of Kabul found a roof under Malwa’s king.

i18n.hi: बाद की कथाएँ भोज को त्रिलोचनपाल जैसे शाही राजकुमार का शरणदाता याद करती हैं। काबुल की निर्वासित वंश को मालवा के राजा के नीचे छत मिली।

panels.shot: close-up on Bhoja and the Shahi prince seated over a map, their hands indicating Hansi and Thanesar, symbolizing shared danger and strategy
panels.action: Bhoja and the Shahi prince sit side by side over a low table bearing a map, their fingers pointing at tiny markings for Hansi and Thanesar as they quietly exchange intense, strategic glances.

dialogue.text: Between Dhara’s pillars, talk turned to frontier towns like Hansi and Thanesar, to Ghaznavid outposts and marching routes, to how far that shadow might reach toward Malwa.

i18n.hi: धारा के स्तंभों के बीच बात सीमा के नगरों—हांसी, थानेसर—की होती, ग़ज़नवी चौकियों और चढ़ाई के रास्तों की, कि वह साया मालवा तक कितनी दूर बढ़ सकता है।

panels.shot: heroic low-angle of Bhoja on a fort rampart, watching troops drill below, Malwa landscape stretching behind him
panels.action: Bhoja stands on a stone rampart overlooking ranks of Malwa soldiers drilling in the courtyard, the dark forests and rivers of Malwa stretching in layers behind his armored form.

dialogue.text: The Udaipur Prashasti praises Bhoja for defeating Turushkas, the term used for certain foreign armies. It shows a king who prepared his plateau for hard encounters.

i18n.hi: उदयपुर प्रशस्ति भोज की तुरुष्कों पर विजय की प्रशंसा करती है—वही नाम जो कुछ विदेशी सेनाओं के लिए चलता था। इसमें एक ऐसा राजा दिखता है जिसने अपने पठार को कड़े टकराव के लिए सजाया।

panels.shot: textured close-up of an inscription slab, Paramara royal titles and boasts carved deep, Turushka reference highlighted by light
panels.action: A weathered stone inscription slab fills the frame, sharp light catching carved words that name Bhoja, his Paramara lineage, and a proud line speaking of Turushka foes bested.

dialogue.text: On stone, the Paramaras carved their claims: that Bhoja struck at Turushkas and raised his own stature among the powers of north India.

i18n.hi: पत्थर पर परमारों ने अपने दावे उकेरे: कि भोज ने तुरुष्कों पर प्रहार किया और उत्तर भारत की शक्तियों में अपना मान ऊँचा उठाया।

panels.shot: dramatic bird’s-eye of a Ghaznavid column crossing a river by night, torches reflected in water, the route bending away from a marked Malwa region
panels.action: Under a moonlit sky, a long Ghaznavid column with sparse torches crosses a broad river, the ink-like path on a faint overlay map curving deliberately away from the shaded Malwa plateau.

dialogue.text: Ferishta and Yahya Sirhindi, writing centuries later, say Mahmud chose a difficult return path, avoiding Param Dev. Many modern historians see Param Dev as a memory of Bhoja’s Malwa.

i18n.hi: फ़रिश्ता और यह्या सिरहिंदी सदियों बाद लिखते हैं कि महमूद ने कठिन वापसी रास्ता चुना, परम देव से बचते हुए। ज़्यादातर आधुनिक इतिहासकार परम देव को भोज के मालवा की याद मानते हैं।

panels.shot: reflective medium shot of Bhoja in council at night, lit by lamps, his advisors debating maps and reports, tension but no open battle
panels.action: At night in the council chamber, Bhoja sits surrounded by lamplight and spread-out maps while advisors argue softly; his face is tense, but no battle standard is yet raised.

dialogue.text: Yet no reliable source shows Bhoja and Mahmud meeting in battle. The clash here, if it came at all, was of routes chosen, borders respected, and risks measured.

i18n.hi: फिर भी कोई भरोसेमंद स्रोत भोज और महमूद की सीधी भिड़ंत नहीं दिखाता। यहाँ संघर्ष, यदि हुआ भी, तो चुने हुए रास्तों, मान रखी सीमाओं और तौले गए ख़तरों का था।

panels.shot: poised wide shot of Bhoja reviewing fortifications, engineers measuring walls, archers on practice, symbolizing preparation rather than conquest
panels.action: Bhoja rides slowly along the inside of a fortress wall as engineers take measurements and archers loose practice shafts, the scene heavy with readiness rather than triumph.

dialogue.text: In Malwa, Bhoja strengthened forts, trained men, and managed alliances. His strength appears not in one famous battle, but in a region kept intact in a turbulent age.

i18n.hi: मालवा में भोज ने किलों को मज़बूत किया, सैनिकों को साधा और सन्धियाँ संभालीं। उसकी ताकत एक मशहूर जंग में नहीं, बल्कि तूफ़ानी दौर में सुरक्षित रहे क्षेत्र में झलकती है।

panels.shot: serene interior of Bhoja’s court with scholars and artists alongside soldiers, blending war-readiness with cultural life
panels.action: Within Dhara’s hall, scholars unroll manuscripts and an artisan sketches a temple plan, while armored guards stand nearby, showing a court where learning and steel share the same space.

dialogue.text: Even as Ghaznavid raids disturbed the northwest, Bhoja’s court fostered learning and building. The Kabul Shahi refugee sat amid Sanskrit poets and architects of dams and shrines.

i18n.hi: ग़ज़नवी हमलों से उत्तर-पश्चिम काँप रहा था, फिर भी भोज का दरबार विद्या और निर्माण को बढ़ा रहा था। काबुल शाही शरणार्थी संस्कृत कवियों और बांध–मंदिरों के शिल्पियों के बीच बैठता था।

panels.shot: wide aftermath shot of a quiet shrine in Malwa, niches empty yet lamps lit, a band of travelers praying in silence
panels.action: A small Malwa shrine stands in dusk light, some niches bare but oil lamps still burning, as a group of tired travelers bows in silent prayer, their bundles set down beside them.

dialogue.text: News of Somnath’s plunder reached far, carried by merchants and pilgrims. In distant shrines, fear and faith lived side by side, under kings like Bhoja who watched the horizon.

i18n.hi: सोमनाथ की लूट की खबर दूर-दूर तक पहुँची, व्यापारियों और यात्रियों के साथ बहती हुई। दूर के देवालयों में डर और आस्था साथ-साथ जीते, भोज जैसे राजा क्षितिज पर नज़र रखे खड़े थे।

panels.shot: introspective close-up on Bhoja at a balcony overlooking Malwa forests, his gaze turned north, soft dawn light on his face
panels.action: At dawn, Bhoja stands alone on a stone balcony above rolling Malwa forests, his eyes fixed on the unseen north, the first light drawing firm lines across his contemplative face.

dialogue.speaker: bhoja_of_dhara
dialogue.text: Not every blow is struck with a sword. Some are turned aside.

i18n.hi: हर चोट तलवार से नहीं लगती। कुछ मोड़ दी जाती हैं।

panels.shot: time-lapse style wide of India’s northern map, old routes fading, new kingdoms appearing, Malwa and Ghazni both morphing over decades
panels.action: A stylized map of northern India shows routes and borders subtly changing over time, Ghazni’s name shifting, Malwa’s outline enduring for a while before new powers arise over it.

dialogue.text: As decades passed, Ghazni’s power changed and new dynasties rose. Bhoja’s reign ended, but the tale of Param Dev remained, half memory, half later imagination.

i18n.hi: साल बीतते गए, ग़ज़नी की ताकत बदली और नए वंश उभरे। भोज का शासन समाप्त हुआ, पर परम देव की कथा बची रही—आधी स्मृति, आधी बाद की कल्पना।

panels.shot: final contemplative medium shot, Bhoja’s statue or later artistic depiction in a quiet museum-like space, lit by a single overhead light
panels.action: A sculpted image of Bhoja stands in a calm gallery, its stone face lit by a lone overhead beam, while faint outlines of maps and inscriptions glow on the walls behind.

dialogue.text: Bhoja of Dhara shows how power can shape even the roads an enemy takes. His legacy reminds us that in history, the battles avoided can speak as loudly as the battles fought.

i18n.hi: धारा का भोज दिखाता है कि शक्ति दुश्मन के रस्तों तक को मोड़ सकती है। उसकी विरासत याद दिलाती है कि इतिहास में बची हुई लड़ाइयाँ भी उतना ही बोलती हैं जितनी लड़ी गई लड़ाइयाँ।

title_i18n.en: Param Dev and the Ghaznavid Shadow

subtitle_i18n.en: When the Shadow from Ghazni Met the Sword of Malwa
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब ग़ज़नी का साया मिला मालवा की तलवार से
